in_hebrew.name: Fachan
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Fachan הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Celtic word 'fach', meaning 'happy' or 'blessed', and the Old English word 'can', meaning 'warrior'. In Christian context, it could represent the blessing and strength given to a warrior in the name of God.
